title: 3D Modeling of Deep Endometriosis From Pelvic MRI
official: Three-Dimensional Modeling of Deep Endometriosis From Pelvic MRI
summary: This retrospective monocentric study aims to assess the feasibility and clinical relevance of three-dimensional (3D) modeling of deep endometriosis lesions derived from pelvic MRI. The study evaluates whether 3D reconstruction improves surgical planning and multidisciplinary management.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient aged 18 years or older
* Confirmed diagnosis of deep endometriosis
* Available and interpretable preoperative pelvic MRI
* Surgical management performed at Strasbourg University Hospital between 01/01/2020 and 12/31/2022
* No documented opposition to reuse of medical data

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient opposition to data reuse
* Patient younger than 18 years
* Incomplete medical records preventing MRI-3D-surgery comparison
* Poor quality or non-interpretable MRI
